Playwright Commands Reference
=============================
page.navigate(url)       - Navigate to a URL
page.locator(selector)   - Create a locator for an element
locator.click()          - Click an element
locator.fill(text)       - Fill an input field
locator.isVisible()      - Check element visibility
locator.innerText()      - Get inner text of element
page.waitForSelector()   - Wait for element to appear in DOM
